D: A boy befriends a giant robot that eats metal.
P: Serve the mains when Hogarth hides the giant in Dean's junkyard.
S: Soft cocoa cakes sandwiched with fluffy marshmallow and vanilla cream, rolled in crushed choc-coated peanuts for a bit of scrapyard crunch. Beat 60g butter with 100g brown sugar and 1 egg, then add 150g plain flour, 30g cocoa, half a tsp bicarb and 120ml buttermilk. Pipe 24 small rounds onto lined trays and bake at 180C for 10 minutes. Beat 80g soft butter with 100g icing sugar, then fold in 100g marshmallow fluff and 1 tsp vanilla. Sandwich the cakes with the filling and roll the edges in 50g crushed chocolate-coated peanuts.
Hogarth's mum works at the diner
Mini apple pies in a muffin tin, shortcrust cases filled with spiced apple, lattice tops, baked at 190C for 25 minutes.
Dough of flour, sugar, eggs, almonds and orange zest shaped into a log, baked at 170C for 25 minutes, sliced, baked again 10 minutes a side until crisp.
M: Beef and pork mince with breadcrumbs, egg and onion, tomato glaze, baked at 180C for an hour, mash and peas.
W: the Giant would eat the tray too

Golden peanut brittle smashed into jagged sheets like scrap from Dean's yard, with flaky salt and a silver dusting of edible lustre. Line a tray with baking paper. Heat 300g caster sugar, 120ml liquid glucose and 80ml water in a heavy pan to 150C on a sugar thermometer. Take off the heat and quickly stir in 250g roasted peanuts, 20g butter and 1 tsp bicarb soda. Pour onto the tray and spread thin. Sprinkle with flaky salt and brush lightly with silver edible lustre. Cool 30 minutes, then smash into jagged shards.
K: one sip of Dean's espresso and Hogarth is off the walls

Vanilla ice cream blended with a shot of espresso, milk and malt, poured thick and topped with whipped cream and chocolate-covered coffee beans. Brew 2 shots espresso and cool, or use decaf for younger kids. Blend with 8 scoops vanilla ice cream, 400ml cold milk and 3 tbsp malted milk powder for 30 seconds until thick. Pour into 4 tall glasses. Top each with whipped cream and a few chocolate-coated coffee beans, or chocolate sprinkles for the little ones.

s.note: Hogarth's mum works at the diner
s.how: Cook 3 diced apples with 3 tbsp sugar and 1 tsp cinnamon for 8 minutes and cool. Line a 12-hole muffin tin with rounds from 2 sheets shortcrust and fill. Top with strips of a third sheet in a lattice and bake at 190C for 25 minutes.

Mix 250g flour, 150g sugar, 1 tsp baking powder, 2 eggs, 100g almonds and the zest of an orange into a dough. Shape into a log and bake at 170C for 25 minutes. Cool 10 minutes, slice and bake again for 10 minutes a side.

m.how: Mix 500g beef mince, 300g pork mince, 60g breadcrumbs, 1 egg and 1 grated onion with salt and pepper. Shape in a tin, glaze with 80ml tomato sauce and bake at 180C for 60 minutes. Serve thick slices with 1kg potatoes mashed with butter and 300g peas.
